title.zh: 规定前保和省省政府所征收的17300墨西哥元及其利息可由该省现政府用于省级事务的法案
title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT SEVENTEEN THOUSAND AND THREE HUNDRED DOLLARS, MEXICAN, AND INTEREST THEREON, COLLECTED BY THE FORMER PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL, MAY BE UTILIZED BY THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT OF THAT PROVINCE FOR PROVINCIAL PURPOSES.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT SEVENTEEN THOUSAND AND THREE HUNDRED DOLLARS, MEXICAN, AND INTEREST THEREON, COLLECTED BY THE FORMER PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF THE PROVINCE OF BOHOL, MAY BE UTILIZED BY THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT OF THAT PROVINCE FOR PROVINCIAL PURPOSES.
title.vi: Đạo luật quy định khoản tiền 17.300 đô la Mexico và lãi phát sinh từ khoản tiền này, do chính quyền tỉnh Bohol trước đây thu được, có thể được chính quyền tỉnh hiện tại sử dụng cho các mục đích tỉnh
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติกำหนดให้เงินจำนวนหนึ่งหมื่นเจ็ดพันสามร้อยดอลลาร์เม็กซิโกและดอกเบี้ยที่เกิดขึ้นจากการเก็บโดยรัฐบาลจังหวัดโบฮอลในอดีตสามารถนำมาใช้โดยรัฐบาลจังหวัดปัจจุบันเพื่อวัตถุประสงค์ของจังหวัด
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan bahwa tujuh belas ribu tiga ratus dolar Meksiko dan bunga yang terkumpul oleh pemerintah provinsi Bohol sebelumnya dapat digunakan oleh pemerintah provinsi tersebut saat ini untuk keperluan provinsi
title.ms: Akta menetapkan bahawa tujuh belas ribu tiga ratus dolar Mexico dan faedah yang dikutip oleh kerajaan wilayah Bohol dahulu boleh digunakan oleh kerajaan wilayah itu kini bagi tujuan wilayah

text.en:
The treasurer of the Province of Bohol is hereby authorized to receive from T. C. Woodbury,
Major, Nineteenth Infantry, United States Army, commanding United States forces in the Island of Bohol, or
his successor, the sum of seventeen thousand three hundred dollars, Mexican currency, together with the
accrued interest thereon, now on deposit with Smith. Bell and Company, and which was originally collected
in the month of January, eighteen hundred and ninety-nine, by the provincial officers of the Island of Bohol,
who were then exercising authority in that island, and to pay the same into the treasury of the present
provincial government of Bohol. The funds so received and paid into the treasury shall be available for the
general purposes of the government of the Province of Bohol, established under Act Numbered One hundred
and seventeen, extending the provisions of the Provincial Government Act to the Province of Bohol. The
treasurer of the Province of Bohol is hereby authorized, upon receiving the money aforesaid, to give proper
vouchers therefor to Major Woodbury, and to Smith, Bell and Company, if necessary, and the receipt of the
treasurer shall be a sufficient voucher to Major Woodbury, or his successor in command, for the disposition
of said money.

The provincial board of the Province of Bohol is hereby empowered to expend of the sum
transferred to the treasurer of the province in the foregoing section, ten thousand dollars for general
educational purposes in the province, subject to the approval and under the supervision of the General
Superintendent of Public Instruction of the Islands.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this Act, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 24, 1901.
